name: Simple Snaplook
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: raytmm
description: This is a simple snaplook mod to be able to change perspectives similar to Snaplook on clients like Lunar and Feather! By default, it is bound to Z (for the back perspective) and X (for the front perspective) though those can be changed in Keybinds
evidence: Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-14 (fa70eeb) (16 classes, 14 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
